messages:
marta: FYI team: we're shipping a gradual rollout for a new SDK+API default called strict_output. Opt-in available today; plan to flip defaults for new keys in 60 days. Docs/QA checklist below.

jun: Can you summarize the user-visible change in one line?

marta: One-liner: the API will start enforcing that generated/chat outputs match user-provided schemas. When strict_output=true + validation_mode=error, mismatches return an error instead of best-effort corrected text.

linh: Which endpoints are affected?

marta: Generation endpoints only: chat, completions, structured generation. Not embeddings, rerank, or fine-tune.

qa-ryan: What's the recommended initial setup for teams testing this?

marta: Recommend: enable strict_output=true in staging with validation_mode=coerce. Run your prompt set. Watch for resp.validation_warnings and validation_time_ms.

zoe-docs: I've published the migration guide draft: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/strict-output-migration (staged). It includes quickstart snippets for py/js/go and a rollback example.

devex-bot: release-note: py-sdk@2.4.1 (docs patch), js-sdk@4.3.1 (adds validation_mode), go-sdk@0.9.1.

jun: What are the modes again?

marta: Modes: 
- legacy (strict_output=false): best-effort, 200 even if shape mismatches.
- strict_output=true + validation_mode=coerce: attempts to coerce into schema, returns 200 with validation_warnings.
- strict_output=true + validation_mode=error: returns 400/422 on mismatch, SDK raises exception.

qa-ryan: CI/testing: do we have a harness to detect regressions programmatically?

marta: Yes. Eng-ml built an eval pipeline that can run schema checks over a prompt corpus. Add it as a CI job. Link: https://internal.redwood.com/evals/strict-output.

zoe-docs: Action items for SDK/docs owners (due dates):
- Update quickstart READMEs to show strict_output opt-in (due in 5 business days).
- Add a CHANGELOG entry for the next SDK release (do it in upcoming PR).
- Add sample pages for common fallbacks and defensive prompts.

jun: Performance impact? Any SLA change?

marta: Minor CPU overhead; typical validation adds ~5-12ms depending on schema complexity. No changes to token billing or SLAs. Metric fields will be added to Console: validation_time_ms, validation_result.

qa-ryan: We should also provide a small test matrix for teams:
- sanity: basic schema match/ mismatch
- edge: partial fields, types swapped
- load: 1000 prompt samples through coerce mode

linh: Rollout timeline?

marta: Roadmap:
- Today: opt-in for all tenants.
- 30 days: dev SDK builds default to coerce for easier testing.
- 60 days: platform default flips for new tenants/keys to strict_output + error. Existing tenants remain legacy unless opt in.
- 180 days: deprecation window starts for legacy path; 30-day final notice before removal.

jun: Who signs the final flip? (security/compliance ok?)

marta: Product + Security + Eng Runtime sign-off. I'm scheduling a sync and will share invite.

zoe-docs: Docs checklist for migration guide includes: examples, SDK snippets, CI integration, FAQ for "my prod app broke", and contact points (marta, linh, #devex).

qa-ryan: I'll make a PR with CI job examples and a small test suite people can copy. ETA: 3 days.

marta: Great — thanks. We'll monitor signal and reach out to customers if we detect fragile patterns. Please leave comments on the staged guide if anything is unclear. :pray:

jun: testing now in staging. report any surprises here.

marta: thanks everyone.
